tajweed_legend_subtitle: Color guide to Quranic recitation rules
rule_ghunnah_desc: 2-count nasalization on Nun and Meem with Shaddah (نّ / مّ).
rule_hamzat_wasl_desc: Connecting Hamza, pronounced at start of speech but silent in continuous recitation.
rule_idghaam_ghunnah_desc: Merging Nun Saakin or Tanween into (ي، ن، م، و) with 2-count nasalization.
rule_idghaam_mutajanisayn_desc: Merging adjacent letters sharing the same articulation point but different characteristics.
rule_idghaam_mutaqaribayn_desc: Merging letters with close articulation points and characteristics (e.g. Qaf into Kaf).
rule_idghaam_no_ghunnah_desc: Complete assimilation of Nun Saakin or Tanween into (ل، ر) without nasalization.
rule_idghaam_shafawi_desc: Merging Meem Saakin into a following Meem with 2-count Ghunnah.
rule_ikhfa_desc: Concealment of Nun Saakin or Tanween before its 15 letters with nasalization.
rule_ikhfa_shafawi_desc: Concealment of Meem Saakin before the letter Ba (ب) with 2-count Ghunnah.
rule_iqlab_desc: Converting Nun Saakin or Tanween into a concealed Meem before Ba (ب) with Ghunnah.
rule_lam_shamsiyyah_desc: The letter Lam in the definite article (ال) is silent and assimilates into the following sun letter.
rule_madd_2_desc: Natural elongation of vowel letters (ا، و، ي) for 2 counts in the origin of the word.
rule_madd_246_desc: Permissible elongation of 2, 4, or 6 counts when stopping on a word (Arid li-Sukoon).
rule_madd_6_desc: Obligatory 6-count elongation caused by an original Sukoon or Shaddah.
rule_madd_munfasil_desc: Permissible elongation (4–5 counts) when Madd letter ends a word and Hamza begins the next.
rule_madd_muttasil_desc: Obligatory elongation (4–5 counts) when Madd letter and Hamza meet within the same word.
rule_qalqalah_desc: Echoing vibration when pronouncing (ق، ط، ب، ج، د) with Sukoon.
rule_silent_desc: Written letters in the Uthmani script that are not vocalized during recitation.
